narratives.Description: Documented form `deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated` fails with unrecognized argument: -- while the direct flag form works. Task strips -- so task invocations pass. Always-loaded AGENTS/commands/hook copy prescribe the separator form for deft as well. This story closes GitHub issue #2680 with a narrowly scoped CLI parse fix and regression coverage.
narratives.Overview:
## Reproduction

On macOS with `@deftai/directive` engine `0.79.3`:

```sh
deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated
```

Result:

```text
verify_session_ritual: unrecognized argument: --
```

The direct option form succeeds:

```sh
deft verify:session-ritual --tier=gated
```

```text
OK session ritual gated tier is fresh.
```

## Expected

Either the documented task-style separator form should be accepted, or the managed `AGENTS.md` / command documentation should prescribe the direct CLI syntax.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-07-20T15:19:55Z)

## Triage analysis (accuracy)

**Verdict: confirmed accurate.**

### Reproduced (local `packages/cli/dist/bin.js` + docs on master)

| Invocation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated` | `verify_session_ritual: unrecognized argument: --` |
| `deft verify:session-ritual --tier=gated` | accepted (flag parsed) |
| `task verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated` | accepted (`task` strips `--` before `CLI_ARGS`) |

### Why docs look "wrong" but aren't accidental

Always-loaded surfaces prescribe the separator form for **both** `task` and `deft`:

- `AGENTS.md` / `content/templates/agents-entry.md`: `deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated`
- `content/commands.md` pre-`start_agent` stack
- Hook deny copy in `packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts` (and its test) embeds the same string

`packages/cli/src/verify-session-ritual.ts` `parseArgs` has no `arg === "--"` skip, so a lone `--` falls through to `unrecognized argument`.

### Preferred fix

Accept and skip a lone `--` in `parseArgs` (and any sibling ritual parsers that share the documented form). Keep documenting the separator form so `task … -- --tier=gated` and `deft … -- --tier=gated` stay interchangeable. Add a regression test that `verify-session-ritual -- --tier=gated` exits the same path as without the separator.

**Cohort:** folding into `bugs-2662-2671` swarm as an additive leaf.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Edit packages/cli/src/verify-session-ritual.ts parseArgs to skip a lone -- separator (continue). 2. Add a unit/integration test file asserting `-- --tier=gated` parses the same as `--tier=gated`. 3. Verify with task check filter session-ritual and note #2680 in CHANGELOG.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive agent following AGENTS.md, I want `deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated` to be accepted, so that documented ritual commands do not fail closed on a bare separator.

narrative.Acceptance: parseArgs skips a lone -- and returns tier=gated for argv [--, --tier=gated] the same as [--tier=gated].
Running deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated no longer emits unrecognized argument: -- and fails closed only on real ritual-state problems.
CHANGELOG Unreleased records the separator acceptance for issue 2680.
